run_metadata.coverage_summary: DEGRADED RUN (network-limited). As on the previous run, the environment's egress policy blocked ALL WebFetch requests this run — every host returned EGRESS_BLOCKED, including government portals (tenders.gov.au, tenders.nsw.gov.au, tenders.vic.gov.au), platforms (vendorpanel.com.au) and even a control host (en.wikipedia.org). Only the WebSearch tool was functional. WebSearch returns result titles, URLs and a short synthesised snippet, but does not permit opening a tender's own detail page, following RSS/JSON feeds, paginating a portal, or reading tender documents. Consequently NO deliverables/requirements/document extraction was possible: every opportunity below is captured at headline level only from search results and flagged pending-detail. Tier 1 (AusTender, buy.nsw) surfaced the most concrete, ID-bearing opportunities; Tier 2 (water GBEs, universities, health) largely re-surfaced items already captured on prior runs; Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery, major-buyer portals) showed no publicly-visible opportunity — all corporate RFx were login/registration-gated as expected. One genuinely new buyer-originated source (Viva Energy Australia) was identified. This run is not representative of live volume; the majority of open opportunities across all tiers could not be reached.
gaps: CRITICAL: All WebFetch/egress was blocked by the environment network policy this run. Every URL fetched returned EGRESS_BLOCKED, including non-government hosts (en.wikipedia.org tested as a control). Only WebSearch was functional. Per the agent-proxy README this is an organisation egress-policy denial, not a TLS/config issue, so it was reported rather than routed around.

Tier 1 core portals could not be read directly: AusTender (tenders.gov.au), NSW buy.nsw/eTendering (tenders.nsw.gov.au), Buying for Victoria (tenders.vic.gov.au), QTenders/supply.qld.gov.au, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders. Only what surfaced in WebSearch snippets could be captured, at headline level.

Detail/deliverables extraction impossible for every entry: no tender detail page or document could be opened. All commercial, requirement, eligibility, evaluation-criteria, contact and document fields are null and require an authenticated / egress-enabled follow-up pass.

South Australia (Tenders SA) coverage failed: WebSearch for 'Tenders SA' returned overwhelmingly SOUTH AFRICAN (Tenders-SA) results; no South Australian opportunity could be reliably isolated. SA deferred to a future run.

Western Australia, Tasmania and NT surfaced only portal-level information (no individually identifiable open tender with title+id) beyond a single unspecified NT Dept of Logistics & Infrastructure item closing 27/08/2026 that lacked a title/ID and was therefore not captured (not fabricated).

Tier 3 corporate: SAP Ariba Discovery and major-buyer portals (BHP, Rio Tinto, Woolworths, Coles, Qantas, banks, telcos) showed no publicly-visible RFx via WebSearch — opportunities are registration- or invitation-gated. Portals recorded in discovered_sources; no corporate opportunity fabricated.
Construction subcontract (EstimateOne, iTWOcx, BidContender): only platform-level information visible; individual builder work-packages are behind free supplier login and could not be read.
Health: a surgical-supplies tender closing 21 Aug 2026 (questions 17 Aug 2026) surfaced in a snippet but with no buyer, ID or title attributable — not captured to avoid fabrication.

The buy.nsw / Transport for NSW entries below were reconstructed from a WebSearch synthesised snippet (no matching result-block deep link and no detail page reachable); their IDs, titles and closing dates should be re-verified on the next egress-enabled run before being relied upon.
